::: {.callout-warning}
## Phase 0 placeholder

This document is scaffolding. It is filled in at **Phase 3**.

The estimate is

$$\text{Revenue} = 0.005 \times B_c \times (1 - \varphi) \times \beta$$

where $B_c$ is the City of Albany taxable sales and purchases base, $\varphi$ the
administrative deduction observed from county distributions, and $\beta$ a
behavioral factor for the 0.5-point rate differential at the city line.
:::
